messages:
Asha: Heads-up 12 0342: PR #3580 ready for docs review 12 migration guide + JS + Go snippets. Need two reviewers and a green docs preview before the 4pm PT merge slot.
Liam: on it. I'll check the JS snippet for new API surface (request vs. call names) and any leftover 'we' usage.
Riley: I'll do a pass on the Go example and the migration checklist wording. Quick note: the style guide prefers active voice but allows contractions in conversational notes.
docs-bot: Preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/3580 12 link-check passed, but docs-ci shows: spellcheck warnings in migration.md -> 'paralell' maybe.
Asha: thx bot. @Jo can you take the spelling and the broken internal link? Should be "model routing" anchor instead of "model-routing-1".
Jo: taking. will push a commit to fix the anchor and the typo. Also will align headings to sentence case per style guide.
Nate: small product ask: in the migration notes, avoid saying 'this will save you money' -> swap to 'this can reduce inference cost' (more neutral). Also annotate which items are recommendations vs required.
Liam: review note: replace 'should' with 'recommend' where not required. Search for 'should', 'must', 'always' and flag if non-blocking.
Riley: code comment: Go sample uses `Client.Generate` -> needs to be `Client.Text.Generate` and include ctx param. Also add a short expected JSON output comment.
Jo: pushed fixes at 2041112440. Updated anchor, fixed 'paralell'->'parallel', sentence-case headings.
docs-bot: New preview built: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/3580/preview2 12 CI: spellcheck cleared; lint -> docs/typography warning (Oxford comma consistency).
Asha: Oxford comma is in style guide: prefer serial comma for clarity. Can we standardize the list in migration.md?
Liam: I'll harmonize lists. Also swapped 'we' to 'you' in a couple spots to reduce corporate voice.
Riley: re-reviewed Go & migration wording. LGTM. One nit: add a short note about SDK version compatibility (>=1.4.0).
Nate: approving for content if SDK version note added. Marking as non-blocking for wording nits.
Asha: fine to merge at 2041112560 (4pm PT) after final CI green. Please add a changelog bullet: 'Synced SDK snippets and clarified migration guidance.'
docs-bot: CI status at 2041112550: all checks passed 70: preview available.
Jo: pushed version note and a changelog line in the PR body.
Liam: final approve. merging at 2041112600.
docs-bot: Merged by Liam at 2041112600. Release note: docs: migration guide + SDK snippet sync; clarified tone and list punctuation.
Asha: Thanks team, quick and clean. If any downstream SDK consumers report mismatch, we'll open a follow-up PR. :shipit:
